explanation: A layer-0 token-identity detector: its input is only the current token's embedding (Pythia has no absolute position embedding and layer 0's MLP sees the token alone), so it peaks at max on the BPE piece ' pre' (case variants 'pre', ' Pre', 'Pre') and fires at or above 0.25 of scale on a fixed, scattered set of some 2,600 vocabulary items, chiefly word-initial pieces of rare technical/learned vocabulary (' rec', ' metabol', ' electrophys', ' prefrontal', ' amygdala', ' cortex', ' html', ' regex', ' Kepler', ' Reich') plus a handful of extent/time words (' Much'/' much', ' early', ' late', ' prior', ' half', ' entire', ' throughout', ' partly'). It reacts to the token identity, not to the letters: whole-word single tokens that merely begin with the same spelling (' prevent', ' present', ' pretty', ' record', ' report', ' prepare', ' previous'), ordinary Anglo-Saxon vocabulary (' house', ' water', ' people'), common technical words (' hypothesis', ' algorithm', ' protein', ' cancer', ' cell'), function words, punctuation and digits all stay below the activity line.
